details: Pajor's sandwich theorem bounds log size by log shattering, and halving uses at most log size.
proof: The sandwich theorem gives $|\mathcal H|\leq |\operatorname{sh}(\mathcal H)|$.  Taking binary logarithms yields $\log|\mathcal H|\leq\log|\operatorname{sh}(\mathcal H)|$.  The pointwise-majority halving algorithm uses at most $\log|\mathcal H|$ queries, so its complexity is at most log shattering.
name: Log Shattering / Majority Complexity
